description: Source code for the HTML_Template_Flexy_Token class, part of a template engine handling tokenization, parsing, and tree building for HTML templates.

classes.name: HTML_Template_Flexy_Token
classes.description: Base class for all tokens in the template engine, providing token creation, tree building, and variable management.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a token object of the specified type, initializing properties.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Converts the token to its string representation using a compiler.

methods.name: compileChildren
methods.description: Recursively compiles child tokens into HTML.

methods.name: buildTokens
methods.description: Runs a tokenizer to generate a token tree from input.

methods.name: buildChildren
methods.description: Builds the children array for a token based on its position and close token.

methods.name: pushState
methods.description: Enters a new variable state block.

methods.name: pullState
methods.description: Exits the current variable state block.

methods.name: toVar
methods.description: Converts a dot notation string to a PHP variable reference.

methods.name: findVar
methods.description: Looks up a variable in the current context, considering scope and privacy options.

methods.name: pushVar
methods.description: Adds a variable to the current scope stack.
